title: The Painted Alibi
author: Oscar Kavanagh
blurb: Jonah Hartwell, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
